description: Unit tests for HttpDownloader class in the org.fdroid.download package, testing download functionality, hash verification, resume capabilities, cache handling, and proxy support.

classes.name: HttpDownloaderTest
classes.description: Test class for HttpDownloader, containing multiple test cases for download, resume, hash verification, cache handling, and proxy support.

methods.name: testDownload
methods.description: Tests basic download functionality with mock engine.

methods.name: testDownloadWithCorrectHash
methods.description: Tests download with hash verification success.

methods.name: testDownloadWithWrongHash
methods.description: Tests download failure due to incorrect hash.

methods.name: testResumeSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful resumption of interrupted download.

methods.name: testMirrorNoResume
methods.description: Tests fallback when a mirror does not support resuming.

methods.name: testResumeWithHashSuccess
methods.description: Tests resuming download with hash verification.

methods.name: testCompleteResumeWithHashSuccess
methods.description: Tests reusing a complete file with correct hash.

methods.name: testCompleteResumeWithHashFailure
methods.description: Tests failure when hash verification fails on resumed file.

methods.name: testResumeError
methods.description: Tests error handling during resume process.

methods.name: testExpectedETagSkipsDownload
methods.description: Checks that matching ETag skips download.

methods.name: testCalculatedETagSkipsDownload
methods.description: Checks that calculated ETag matching skips download (ignored scenario).

methods.name: testTorProxy
methods.description: Tests download via Tor proxy when Tor is running.

methods.name: isTorRunning
methods.description: Helper function to check if Tor proxy port is active.
